scripts.build: npm run build -w @otter/shared && npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run build -w @otter/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,blue "npm run dev -w @otter/server" "npm run dev -w @otter/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @otter/shared && npm run test -w @otter/server && npm run test -w @otter/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @otter/shared && npm run typecheck -w @otter/server && npm run typecheck -w @otter/web
scripts.test:model:low-signal: npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run test:model:low-signal -w @otter/server
scripts.test:model:expression: npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run test:model:expression -w @otter/server
scripts.test:emotion: npm run build -w @otter/shared && npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run test -w @otter/server -- emotion && node server/dist/scripts/emotion-evaluation.js --validate-only
scripts.test:model:emotion: npm run build -w @otter/shared && npm run build -w @otter/server && node server/dist/scripts/emotion-evaluation.js --model
scripts.report:emotion: npm run build -w @otter/shared && npm run build -w @otter/server && node server/dist/scripts/emotion-evaluation.js && node server/dist/scripts/emotion-expression-report.js
scripts.test:memory: npm run build -w @otter/shared && npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run test:memory -w @otter/server
scripts.test:model:memory: npm run build -w @otter/shared && npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run test:model:memory -w @otter/server
scripts.report:structured-capability: npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run report:structured-capability -w @otter/server
scripts.report:structured-ab: npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run report:structured-ab -w @otter/server
scripts.report:state-parity: npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run report:state-parity -w @otter/server
scripts.promptfoo:validate: npm run build -w @otter/server && node node_modules/cross-env/dist/bin/cross-env.js PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=test-results/.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=true PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION=true node node_modules/promptfoo/dist/src/entrypoint.js validate -c promptfoo/promptfooconfig.mjs
scripts.test:promptfoo:offline: npm run build -w @otter/server && node node_modules/cross-env/dist/bin/cross-env.js PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=test-results/.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true PROMPTFOO_OFFLINE=true PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=true PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION=true node node_modules/promptfoo/dist/src/entrypoint.js eval -c promptfoo/promptfooconfig.mjs --no-share --no-cache --max-concurrency 2 --output test-results/promptfoo-offline.json
scripts.test:promptfoo:model: npm run build -w @otter/server && node node_modules/cross-env/dist/bin/cross-env.js PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=test-results/.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true PROMPTFOO_OFFLINE=false PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=true PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION=true node node_modules/promptfoo/dist/src/entrypoint.js eval -c promptfoo/promptfooconfig.mjs --no-share --no-cache --max-concurrency 2 --output test-results/promptfoo-model.json
scripts.report:prompt-regression: npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run report:prompt-regression -w @otter/server
scripts.report:p1-legacy-baseline: npm run build -w @otter/server && npm run report:p1-legacy-baseline -w @otter/server
scripts.prepackage:testable: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:healing && npm run test:eval:core && npm run test:eval:healing && npm run test:eval:skill:astrology && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e:demo && npm run test:e2e:full && npm run test:model
